name: Sentinel Rook
text: Before bidding, swap your three lowest cards for your partner's three highest.

signature.target: your three lowest, partner's three highest

archetypes: Nil Guard; splash Nil Champion, Blind Bidder
role: Enabler (creates partner-nil rounds for every Nil Guard payoff)
decision: How to bid a hand that now holds your partner's best cards, and whether your stronger hand can cover a partner who is now weak enough to bid nil.
opponent: The swap is shown to the table before anyone bids, so opponents bid knowing your team's strength has moved to one seat.
aiNote: Bid the strengthened hand normally. The partner bids from its weakened hand, so it bids nil whenever its nil heuristic allows.
rationale: Every Nil Guard payoff except Roommates' Apartment needs a partner nil, and a neutral partner rarely bids one. Moving the partner's three highest cards to you before bidding makes a nil hand out of an average one, so the partner bids nil far more often on its own judgment, and your hand now holds the high cards that cover it. In those rounds Sheltering Castle, Shared Blanket, Lifeguard's Buoy, Guarded Lock, Rescuing Ambulance, Shouldered Backpack, and Half-Lit Menorah can all fire. In rounds without a nil, the team's strength sits in one seat, which suits Kingmaker and High Card splashes. It differs from Sheltering Castle (DU-S15: two cards, after bidding, only on a partner nil).
deviation: Redesigned from changing the partner's bid to nil, because sigils change only their owner's bid. It now creates partner nils by weakening the partner's hand before bidding.
